`class VideoResourceFormat`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/iresourceformat/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.format.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [VideoResourceFormat.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/format/impl/VideoResourceFormat.java)

The built-in format of MP4, Matroska (MKV, WebM) and AVI files, played as videos with FFmpeg.

## Description

A video needs the FFmpeg natives, which JOID downloads on the first use ([`VideoNatives`](/reference/resources/videonatives/)).
